title: Repeat the D=-43 endpoint comparison with a generic degree-11 recurrence
status_note: Prospective experiment only; not runnable or published to cairn. Implementation, independent verification and a frozen protocol must land before ready promotion.
blocked_on: pr:1888 verified conductor-gap baseline and inputs must merge
note:Implement and independently replay the q=11 recurrence arm and a blinded fresh-target cohort driver.
question: Does the ten-gap D=-43 query-count signal repeat on fresh public targets after adding the generic degree-11 recurrence control?
decision_value: A fresh-target repeat distinguishes the current small-family signal from target/query noise. A repeated phase-specific effect merits a larger preregistered population; parity or censoring does not support a conductor-hardness claim.

resources.notes: Planning estimate only: 100 IC attempts and 40 matched rho attempts for ten gaps and two fresh targets per endpoint, allowing several minutes per cold IC attempt, replay and setup. Six core-hours and four wall-hours are provisional estimates, not bounds; the driver has a four-hour wall cap.
